def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Side-by-side panels separated by a constant-color divider.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        # Mark coincident non-background pixels, keeping the right panel's
        # background color elsewhere.
        bg = max(set(v for row in right for v in row),
                 key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in right))
        return [[3 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] not in (0, bg)

                   if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == 9 and bottom[r][c] == 9 else 9
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
